coverage_notes: Swept 7 major research angles: (1) Database visualization & BI market (Tableau, Power BI, Qlik, ThoughtSpot); (2) Graph databases (Neo4j, TigerGraph, ArangoDB, Stardog); (3) Data warehouses/analytics (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery); (4) Workflow/agent builders (n8n, Zapier, Make, Vellum, StackAI); (5) Low-code/no-code platforms (OutSystems, Microsoft Power Apps, ServiceNow, Bubble, Webflow, Adalo, FlutterFlow); (6) Vector databases & RAG tooling (Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Qdrant); (7) Data infrastructure & pipeline tools (Airbyte, Fivetran, Talend, Airflow, Prefect, Dagster). Analyst coverage includes Gartner Magic Quadrant (BI, Low-Code, Data Governance, Data Quality), Forrester Wave (Low-Code Platforms Q2 2025), IDC MarketScape. Primary databases consulted: Crunchbase, PitchBook, YCDB, a16z Portfolio, Tracxn, SEC Edgar, GitHub. Market sizing data from MarketsandMarkets, Grand View Research, Precedence Research, Roots Analysis, IMARC Group. Deduplication across vendor-published sources, analyst reports, and comparative guides yielded ~40 unique high-value sources. Notable omissions: MetroGraph self-row requires GitHub verification (not found in public web); SignalDB requires direct repository inspection; proprietary pricing pages (paywalled, accessible only to subscribers). Coverage spans T0 (primary databases, live VC data), T1 (analyst reports, official docs), T2 (academic HCI research, textbooks, technical guides), and T3 (vendor blogs, comparison essays).
